description: Ministry of Labour - Notice of repudiation of Collective Agreement No. 38 of 2014, from John Keels PLc. CIC Holding :PLC and Mackwoods (Privete) Limited
reasoning: This gazette content concerns the repudiation and cessation of a collective agreement under the Industrial Disputes Act. It is a legal notice published by the Acting Commissioner of Labour in accordance with specific statutory provisions (Section 9 of the Act). The core subject matter is the modification of a legal/regulatory framework governing industrial relations, which fits the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (new laws, regulations, legal amendments, and statutory instruments).
